notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello, robinsons!

The VAST Corporation keeps on perfecting the base.

This update contains:
[list]
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] Improved descriptions of the machines
[*] Now you need to spend fewer crystals to unlock upgrade units
[*] Botanical Unit becomes available right after Desert-lvl3
[*] Your death is not a waste: now you will gain experience after death and skill points after level-ups
[*] Improved gamepad controls
[*] Optimization, fine-tuning, delicate polishing
[/list]

Go Robinsons!

notes.title: Great Update
Bugfix
notes.notes:
Ethan is a wrench expert and is able to fix everything!

What was fixed:

[list]
[*] passing through walls at low FPS
[*] freezing in the battle with the boss on the 3rd stage 
[*] problem with text in dialogues at low FPS 
[*] camera shake after killing the boss and returning to the base
[*] now after clearing the sector, the teleport is waiting for you fully charged
[/list]

You go, robinsons!
